name: @activepieces/piece-heymarket-sms
description: Heymarket is a business texting platform that gives you the power to engage with people using shared inboxes.

auth.description: Enter your Heymarket API Key. You can find it in your Heymarket account settings.

createOrUpdateContact.name: createOrUpdateContact
createOrUpdateContact.description: Create a new contact or update an existing contact by phone number

phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434)

is_opted_out.description: Whether the contact is opted out of messaging

contact_id.description: Contact ID for updating an existing contact. If not provided, will attempt to create a new contact

overwrite.description: When true, replaces all existing custom fields. When false, merges with existing ones. Note: contact name is always overwritten

aiMetadata.description: Upserts a Heymarket contact, keyed on phone number (E.164 without the leading plus, e.g. 14155553434). Supplying a Contact ID updates that existing record; omitting it creates a new contact. Use this to sync contact details (name, email, tags, opt-out) before messaging. Idempotent: re-running with the same phone/Contact ID converges on the same contact rather than duplicating; the Overwrite flag controls whether custom fields are replaced or merged.

sendCustomMessage.name: sendCustomMessage
sendCustomMessage.description: Send a custom text message to an individual contact or a list

inbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent

creator_id.description: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list or chat

targets.description: Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages

aiMetadata.description: Sends a free-form SMS/MMS text from a Heymarket inbox. Route to a single recipient via Phone Number, or supply multiple numbers in Group Targets for a group MMS. Requires the sending Inbox ID and Creator ID (the member sending). Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new message.

sendTemplateMessage.name: sendTemplateMessage
sendTemplateMessage.description: Send a message using a template to an individual contact or a list

inbox_id.description: Unique identifier for the inbox from which the message will be sent

creator_id.description: Unique identifier for the sender (member ID from Get Inboxes)

template_id.description: Unique identifier for the Heymarket template to send

phone_number.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign (e.g. 14155553434). Required if not sending to a list

targets.description: Array of phone numbers in E.164 format without the plus sign for group MMS messages

text.description: Optional message text body to override or supplement the template

aiMetadata.description: Sends a message built from a saved Heymarket template (by Template ID) from a given inbox. Route to a single recipient via Phone Number, or supply multiple numbers in Group Targets for a group MMS; optional override text supplements the template. Requires the sending Inbox ID and Creator ID. Not idempotent: each call dispatches a new message.

updateList.name: updateList
updateList.description: Update an existing list in your team by adding or removing members, or updating list properties

list_id.description: Unique identifier for the list to update

add_phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to add to the list (e.g. 14155553434)

remove_phone.description: Phone number in E.164 format without the plus sign to remove from the list (e.g. 14155553434)

members.description: Object of list targets. Keys are phone numbers, values are objects with optional first name (f) and last name (l)

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Heymarket list identified by List ID: rename it and/or add or remove members by phone number (E.164 without the leading plus), or set the full member set via the Members object. List ID and the (possibly unchanged) title are required. Idempotent: re-running with the same inputs converges on the same list membership and name.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

auth.description: Enter your Heymarket API Key. You can find it in your Heymarket account settings.

headers.description: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.

auth.description: Enter your Heymarket API Key. You can find it in your Heymarket account settings.

response_is_binary.description: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.

chatStarted.name: chatStarted
chatStarted.description: Trigger when a new conversation is started or an existing conversation is updated

userId.description: The Heymarket user ID for verification. This is the ID of a team member who has access to the inboxes.

inboxId.description: The Heymarket inbox IDs to monitor for new conversations

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a conversation in the monitored Heymarket inbox(es) is started or updated (e.g. a new message arrives or its status changes). Polls for conversations updated since the last run, scoped to the configured Inbox IDs and verifying User ID. Emits each new or changed conversation.

newOrUpdatedContact.name: newOrUpdatedContact
newOrUpdatedContact.description: Trigger when a new contact is created or an existing contact is updated

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a Heymarket contact is created or any of its details change (name, email, phone, tags, opt-out status). Polls the team contact list for records updated since the last run and emits each new or changed contact.

pt.Heymarket is a business texting platform: Heymarket é uma plataforma de texto de negócios que lhe dá o poder de se envolver com pessoas usando caixas de entrada compartilhadas.
pt.Enter your Heymarket API Key. You can fi: Digite sua chave de API do Heymarketing. Você pode encontrá-la nas suas configurações de conta da Heymarketing.
pt.Create a new contact or update an existi: Criar um novo contato ou atualizar um contato existente por número de telefone
pt.Send a custom text message to an individ: Enviar uma mensagem de texto personalizada para um contato individual ou uma lista
pt.Send a message using a template to an in: Enviar uma mensagem usando um modelo para um contato individual ou uma lista
pt.Update an existing list in your team by: Atualize uma lista existente em sua equipe, adicionando ou removendo membros, ou atualizando as propriedades da lista
pt.Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
pt.Phone number in E.164 format without the: Número de telefone no formato E.164 sem o sinal de mais (por exemplo, 14155553434)
pt.Whether the contact is opted out of mess: Se o contato está excluído da mensagem
pt.Contact ID for updating an existing cont: ID de contato para atualizar um contato existente. Se não for fornecido, tentará criar um novo contato
pt.When true, replaces all existing custom: Quando verdadeiro, substitui todos os campos personalizados existentes. Quando falso, funde com os existentes. Nota: nome de contato é sempre substituído por outro.
pt.Unique identifier for the inbox from whi: Identificador exclusivo para a caixa de entrada a partir da qual a mensagem será enviada
pt.Unique identifier for the sender (member: Identificador exclusivo para o remetente (ID de membro de Obter Caixa de Entrada)
pt.Phone number in E.164 format without the: Número de telefone no formato E.164 sem o sinal de mais (por exemplo, 14155553434). Necessário se não enviar para uma lista ou chat
pt.Array of phone numbers in E.164 format w: Array de números de telefone no formato E.164 sem sinal de mais para mensagens MMS de grupo
pt.Unique identifier for the Heymarket temp: Identificador exclusivo para o modelo Heymarket a ser enviado
pt.Phone number in E.164 format without the: Número de telefone no formato E.164 sem o sinal de mais (por exemplo, 14155553434). Necessário se não enviar para uma lista
pt.Optional message text body to override o: Corpo de texto da mensagem opcional para substituir ou suplementar o modelo
pt.Unique identifier for the list to update: Identificador exclusivo da lista para atualizar

Número de telefone no formato E.164 sem o sinal de mais a ser removido da lista (por exemplo, 141555534)
